summary: The proof is sequentially complete. The mixed-integer and ordinary Helly reductions use the correct subfamily cardinalities; minimal planar infeasibility yields strictly positive Farkas multipliers and, in the surviving six-index branch, two disjoint triples with rank-two planar normals; the affine certificates give the claimed exact open-versus-closed section thresholds, including equality cases. The private-point, area, triangular-complement, midpoint, shifted-profile, and upper-leakage arguments preserve all required strict inequalities and boundary conventions.
